whiz.definition: n. a buzzing or hissing sound as of something traveling rapidly through the air
whiz.translation:
n. 飕飕声, 精明的人, 专家
v. (使)飕飕作声

whiz kid.translation: n. 神童, 优等生; 高才生

whiz-bang.translation:
n. 爆竹的一种；自动操纵的飞弹；杰出的人或事物
a. 杰出的

whiz-kid.definition: n. someone whose career progresses rapidly
whiz-kid.translation: n. <口><贬>迅速获得成功的人

whiz-kids.translation: (whiz-kid 的复数) n. <口><贬>迅速获得成功的人

whizbang.definition:
n. a small high-velocity shell; it makes a whizzing sound followed by a bang when it hits
n. a firecracker that (like the whizbang shell) makes a whizzing sound followed by a loud explosion

whizz.definition: v. make a soft swishing sound
whizz.translation:
n. 飕飕声, 精明的人, 专家
v. (使)飕飕作声

whizz kid.translation: [美国英语]；神童, 奇才；优秀学生；绝顶聪明能干的青年人[亦作 whizz-kid, whiz-kid]

whizz-kid.definition: n. someone whose career progresses rapidly
whizz-kid.translation: n. （尤指在金融方面的）神童, 奇才

whizz-kids.definition: n. someone whose career progresses rapidly

whizzbang.definition:
n. a small high-velocity shell; it makes a whizzing sound followed by a bang when it hits
n. a firecracker that (like the whizbang shell) makes a whizzing sound followed by a loud explosion
whizzbang.translation:
n. [旧俚语](一种爆炸力很强的)高速炮弹；(一种)速爆烟火；[美国俚语] =whiz (2.)
a. [美国俚语]杰出的, 优秀的；很有用的；充满生气的；壮观的

whizzbangs.translation:
(whizzbang 的复数) n. [旧俚语](一种爆炸力很强的)高速炮弹；(一种)速爆烟火；[美国俚语] =whiz (2.)
a. [美国俚语]杰出的, 优秀的；很有用的；充满生气的；壮观的

whizzed.definition: v make a soft swishing sound

whizzes.definition:
n someone who is dazzlingly skilled in any field
v make a soft swishing sound
whizzes.translation:
n. 飕飕声( whiz的名词复数 ); 能手; 专家; 有吸引力的东西; 飕飕声( whizz的名词复数 ); 熟手; 能手; 奇才
v. 发出飕飕声( whiz的第三人称单数 ); <口>高速移动; 飕飕作声( whizz的第三人称单数 ); 飕飕掠过, 急驰; 使飕飕作声

whizzing.definition: v make a soft swishing sound
